$comment: Brazilian Portuguese typography: curly double quotes, curly single quotes nested, the curly apostrophe (rare: d’água). macOS pt-BR quotes with “%@” (442 pairs across Finder and System Settings in the reference pile, no guillemets); the pt-PT «» is a variant tell. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: pt-BR writes the percent sign tight to its number (50%), as macOS pt-BR does
no space before a sentence’s ! ? ; : in Portuguese (the French habit); a literal ? or ! mid-sentence, like a wildcard, isn’t punctuation

hedges.why: a bracketed gender or plural ending (selecionado(a), arquivo(s)); use ICU plural/select, or rephrase so nothing agrees
a slashed gender ending (conectado/a, o/a); use ICU select, or rephrase so nothing agrees
